fields.local: session open-close in the exchange time zone
fields.open_day_offset: -1 means the session opens on the prior calendar day
fields.et_jan: the same session in US Eastern time on a January date (US standard time)
fields.et_jul: the same session in US Eastern time on a July date (US daylight time)
fields.kind: ltd = last trading day, fnd = first notice day (as given by FuturesClock)
